The '''''Jeweled Delight''''' was a [[Hapan Battle Dragon]] and [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]] when in [[44 ABY]] she traveled from [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] to [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] to attend the anti-slavery meeting there, and secretly met her daughter [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]].
